message: Astra: Can we set aside the unresolved numerical-provenance correction, whose claims are not yet verified, without treating “Based on these plans” as an observation? To keep your aim, “let's analyze the study results in more detail,” could you choose one task contrast and write an English sentence whose support you can locate in the available source description? Would further thinking about that contrast be worth more than attempting the sentence now? What unresolved uncertainty would instead justify staying with the question? What evidence would decide, and can you carry out your chosen step here?
speaker: Astra
